issues.on_page: column 2 values printed about one row below their line labels (e.g. 184.40 B29 on the line 3 Investments row, 75,395.11 B45 on the line 20 row)
issues.issue: The skewed scan puts the numbers one row off their labels. The extractor matched them by B-code (B29-B56). That matching is consistent with the form layout and the arithmetic (174,183.53 + 162,084.22 - 203,115.15 = 133,152.60), but it is an assumption about which label each number belongs to. In particular, 17,473.79 (B47) is taken as Other Capital Outlay and 110,246.25 (B48) as Bond Principal & Interest.
